Hi Chloe,

Thank you for your claim CLM-3008 from FitLife Paris. The expense is a monthly gym membership. Under our expense policy, gym, fitness and wellness memberships can never be reimbursed, and the category chosen on the claim doesn't change that. So we have recommended that this claim be rejected. A finance reviewer will make the final decision.

You don't need to do anything else for this claim. If you have other business expenses, you can submit them in the usual way.

Finance Operations
